summary: Sphere 3D Corp. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $10.3 million of common shares through sales agents A.G.P. and Maxim, under an amended sales agreement adding Maxim. The offering is a routine capital raise under Rule 415, not a special situation. Terms include a 3% commission, no escrow, and sales at prevailing market prices. The company’s public float is about $46.1 million, subject to the Baby Shelf Limitation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a standard shelf takedown, with no special-situation event such as acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review. What to watch: potential dilution and market impact from ongoing ATM sales.
